description:
YouTube
==
- feat(YouTube - Change start page): Add more start pages https://github.com/inotia00/revanced-patches/pull/136
- feat(YouTube - Hide ads): Add `Hide end screen store banner` setting https://github.com/inotia00/revanced-patches/pull/131
- feat(YouTube - Hide feed flyout menu): Add `Feed flyout menu filter type` setting
- feat(YouTube - Hide layout components): Add `Account menu filter type` setting (Close https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2574)
- feat(YouTube - Seekbar components): Add option to use custom seekbar accent color (For YouTube 19.25.39+, Close https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2738)
- fix(YouTube - Change live ring click action): Channel does not open when the live ring of Shorts live stream is clicked
- fix(YouTube - Change live ring click action): Sometimes channel opens even if the live ring is not clicked
- fix(YouTube - Change live ring click action): Update patch limitation
- fix(YouTube - Hide ads): New types of ads are shown https://github.com/ReVanced/revanced-patches/issues/4352
- fix(YouTube - Hide feed components): Podcasts subpage is empty when `Hide carousel shelves` is on
- fix(YouTube - Hide feed components): `Hide Playables` not working https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2485
- fix(YouTube - Hide feed components): `Hide community posts in subscriptions` not working https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2729
- fix(YouTube - Settings): All patches fail due to `Cairo Fragment` patch in some environments https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2730


YouTube Music
==
- feat(YouTube Music - Change start page): Add more start pages https://github.com/inotia00/revanced-patches/pull/135
- feat(YouTube Music - Spoof app version): Remove the version that is no longer valid https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2743
- feat(YouTube Music - Spoof client): Add support for latest versions, Remove `Spoof streaming data` patch
- fix(YouTube Music - Dark theme): Gradient layer overlaps
- fix(YouTube Music - Settings): ListPreference dialog always selects default value https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2731


Shared
==
- build: Bump Gradle
- fix(GmsCore support): Add missing permissions and intents
- fix(GmsCore support): Remove unnecessary provider hooking


Announcement
==
- YouTube Music's support version has been upgraded to **7.25.53 / 8.02.53**, but please read the following issue and upgrade only if necessary: https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2554.
- Compatible ReVanced Manager: [RVX Manager v1.23.5 (fork)](https://github.com/inotia00/revanced-manager/releases/tag/v1.23.5).
